title: Ferri-Calcite
summary: FERRI-CAL'CITE, noun [Latin ferrum, iron, and calx, lime.] A species of calcarious earth or limestone combined with a large portion of iron, from 7 to 14 per cent.

inlines.v: FERRI-CAL'CITE, noun [Latin ferrum, iron, and calx, lime.] A species of calcarious earth or limestone combined with a large portion of iron, from 7 to 14 per cent.
